entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 388 aa protein; sequence analysis identified Flavoprotein domain PF02441.26 at residues 2-158 and DFP domain PF04127.23 at residues 172-379.
Best reviewed homolog is Bacillus subtilis CoaBC O35033 with 59.5% identity, 99.0% query coverage, and E-value 8.77e-155.
Homolog annotation supports bifunctional CoA biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase.
Inferred cofactors are FMN and Mg2+, based on reviewed CoaBC homolog annotation; exact cofactor binding is homology-based for the query.

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Bifunctional enzyme in bacterial coenzyme A biosynthesis; catalyzes EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36.
The ligase step forms N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine from (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate, L-cysteine, and CTP, releasing CMP and diphosphate.
The decarboxylase step converts N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine to (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine and CO2.
Reviewed homolog annotations report one FMN per subunit and Mg2+ as cofactor/metal requirement.

entities.name: CoA ligase step RHEA:19397
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP = N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+).
This is the phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity, EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: CoA decarboxylase step RHEA:16793
observations: This is the phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity, EC 4.1.1.36.
